pages.text: The blast furnace melts iron ore into $(item)molten steel$(). It is a hollow brick tower with a $(item)Blast Furnace Output$() at its foot.

$(l)What goes in$()$(li)$(item)Ore$(): crushed raw iron, raw iron, or quartz.$(li)$(item)Flux$(): limesand, one per iron item.$(li)$(item)Fuel$(): coal coke dust, the only fuel it burns.$(li)$(item)Hot air$(): piped into a hatch in the wall, from a blast stove.
$(l)What comes out$()$(li)$(item)Molten steel$() and $(item)molten slag$(), pumped from the output block.$(li)$(item)Furnace gas$(), collected by a hatch on top. It fuels the blast stove.

Before you start, have a coke oven making coke, crushing wheels turning coke into dust and limestone into limesand, and a working hot air line (previous chapters). Steel is then cast into ingots in a casting basin (next chapter).
